title: Tell a story about trying your best
text: One day, Liu Tao wanted to play the Monkey King in a school play. He liked the Monkey King very much. But he ______ (be) not good at acting.
Liu Tao wanted to try his best. He practised every day. He ______ (watch) the Monkey King on TV. Then he ______ (practise) in front of the mirror. He ______ (remember) all the words and movements.
Finally, the play ______ (begin). Liu Tao acted well. He was very happy. His teachers and friends ______ (be) happy for him too.
sentences: One day, Liu Tao wanted to play the Monkey King in a school play.
He liked the Monkey King very much.
Liu Tao wanted to try his best.
Then he practised in front of the mirror.
His teachers and friends were happy for him too.
